sloka: तमभ्रघनसङ्काशमापतन्तं महाकपिम् ।दृष्ट्वा ते वानराः सर्वे तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा ।। 5.57.29 ।।।।
transliteration: tamabhraghanasaṅkāśamāpatantaṁ mahākapim ।dṛṣṭvā te vānarāḥ sarve tasthuḥ prāñjalayastadā ।। 5.57.29 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the vanara, who resembled a mountain, descended with great speed on the summit of mount Mahendra full of trees.
